analysis:
Speaking at the second meeting of the Standing Committee of Chief Ministers on Naxalism on 13 April 2006, Manmohan Singh said it would not be an exaggeration to call naxalism the single biggest internal security challenge ever faced by the country. He also said the movement had spread to over 160 districts.

The assessment was consistent with the casualty pattern of the period. MHA data show LWE incidents peaking at 2,258 in 2009 and deaths at 1,005 in 2010, before a gradual decline.

The statement is a characterisation rather than a numeric target. It is recorded as true because the government's own data for 2005-2010 show LWE as one of the largest and most persistent internal-security challenges of the period.
notes: Quote read in the PIB transcript of the 13 April 2006 speech. 'Single biggest ... challenge' is an assessment; the verdict reflects consistency with MHA casualty data, not a statistical test. The 'over 160 districts' figure is from the same speech and was not separately checked against an MHA list.
